summary.text: Jason Robbins is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Sylvia Grot for a seat with no incumbent. In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he supports the MiCare health care legislation.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jason Robbins's profession as director, and he advanced from the Democratic primary for District 59 on August 4, 2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he named health care, removing money from politics, and increasing wages and benefits as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
He said he opposes data center investment and criticized DTE, saying Michigan residents do not want either.
He listed Planned Parenthood as an endorser.
